profile.headline: SRE | Platform | DevOps | CI/CD | GCP | Observability | FinOps
profile.summary:
Site Reliability Engineer with 8+ years of expertise in managing and optimizing cloud infrastructure for large-scale deployments. Proficient in Azure, AWS, GCP, Python, and Terraform, with a proven track record of enhancing operational efficiency and reducing costs. Passionate about leveraging innovative solutions to ensure high system uptime and drive continuous improvement in cloud operations.

- Proficient in AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Docker, CI/CD, and Kafka
- Unix server administration and tuning : Linux / RedHat / CentOS / Ubuntu
- Experience with monitoring tools such as Splunk, Prometheus, Loki, Elastic, Kibana, and Coralogix (SAAS)
- Passionate about working on emerging technologies and tools stack
- Proven hands-on technical leader and problem solver that consistently delivers results

Certifications: 

CKA: Certified Kubernetes Administrator
Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
CCNA Cisco Certified Network Associate

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Jose, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Sr Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
Global On-Call & Reliability Ownership: Actively participate in a 24/7 global SRE rotation, owning end-to-end incident management, driving resolution well within SLO targets, and maintaining 99.68% system availability across 700+ environments.  
Workload Migration & Cost Optimization: Collaborated across teams to migrate entire platform workloads to custom compute classes; authored a Python storage engine and executed K8s rightsizing—cutting storage overhead by 40% and delivering $8M+ in annual OpEx savings.  
Operator Automation & Toil Reduction: Built a custom K8s Operator/CronJob to dynamically enforce CPU/memory requests based on customer ingestion volume; engineered Go/Python CLI tools saving 200+ engineering hours annually and cutting alert toil by 40+ hrs/month.  
Enterprise Observability & OTel: Deployed a GKE observability stack using Dynatrace Operator and OpenTelemetry (OTel); configured OTTL transformers to stream Prometheus metrics from 100+ microservices.  
GitOps & Platform Engineering: Architected declarative GitOps workflows using Argo CD, Helm, and GitHub Actions; built reusable Terraform modules and migrated event-driven autoscaling to KEDA.  
IaC & Disaster Recovery: Orchestrated secure multi-region infrastructure for 700+ customer environments using Terraform, Ansible, Vault, and Consul; engineered automated DR snapshot workflows to meet strict RTO/RPO targets.

positions.title: Sr System Engineer
positions.description:
Member of Support Engineering team for @fluentd and @fluentbit

Helping customers to onboard Fluentd and Fluentbit in large-scale infrastructure.
Solving Architectural issues like memory leaks, CPU spikes, latency, and reliability.
Reproduce customer reporting issues and bugs, also coordinating with developers for bug fixing.
Partnered with Developers on validating features, improving documentation, and helping to improve product quality.
Facilitating weekly meetings with Customer and Support team, discussing prioritize tickets, enhancements requests, etc.
Supporting level 1, 2, and 3 tickets to our clients. Also, testing new features and coordinating with the developer team for bug fixing. 
Work with a Solution engineer to run benchmark testing, consultation, and creating documentation.
Manages/leads a team of 3 and closely works with our clients and Solution engineers

Technologies
- Linux, Windows, Kubernetes, Docker, and Kafka
- AWS, GCP, and Azure
- Vault and packer 
- Configuration management like Ansible and Puppet
- CI/CD developed for Fluentd - Github -> Jenkins -> Ansible -> Fluentd/Fluentbit
- Prometheus, Garfana, Elastic, Kibana,  Splunk, Loki, and Coralogix. 
- Bash and Python scripting to automate the simple task for testing.

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description:
Solid understanding of infrastructure services of Microsoft Azure, AWS and GCP
Solid knowledge of switches, routers and security devices.
Expertise of LAN and WAN configuration and troubleshooting.
Expertise of Microsoft Azure IAAS services like vm, vnet, VPN gateway, NSG, azure backup, azure file sync, vnet peering, scale set, azure load balancer, application gateway, DNS zone and disk.
Building vpn with multiple tunnels connected for vpn failover, managing routing, centralized administration of remote vpn users using various authentication methods like active directory and okta
Office 365 administration, identity management and Azure single sign-on using Azure AD connect. 
Monitoring network devices using IP Switch and Zabbix
Active Directory, domain controller, configuring multi-domains forest environment, building trust relation between domain tree and forest. 
Windows services DFS namespace and replication, WSUS using GPO, print server, RDP licensing
Experience supporting and testing LANs, VLANs, WLANs, VPNs, and DHCP servers.
Managing and maintaining Palo Alto next-generation firewall including PA200, PA220, and PA500 (VPN, Global Protect, URL Filtering, VR, PBF, and Content-ID) 
Configuring firewall and SD-WAN using SRX110, SRX220, SRX300, SSG5, SSG10 (screenOS), FortiGate 50, 60, 80, 90, Cisco ASA 5505, 5510, 5506, and 5508
Configure and managing Cisco catalyst 2960, 3560 meraki cloud-managed switches.
Layer 2 protocols STP, Ether Channel, Aggregation, and Port security
Cisco wireless solution including aironet 1800/2800 and LAN controller 3504
Deployed highly available VMWare infrastructure ESXi 6/6.5, vCenter server, vMotion, and VMWare update manager
Design and enterprise backup solution using Veeam, Symantec and Azure backup
NetApp FAS system using advance root partitioning, disk management, failover group, auto support, and lifs
ONTAP, Dell Equallogic, FreeNAS, iSCSI, SAN, SMB, CIFS and NAS configuration
